criticism: The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The condition 'balances[msg.sender] >= _value && _value > 0' allows attackers to set balances to 2^256, causing a denial of service attack.

The transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The condition 'balances[_from] >= _value && allowed[_from][msg.sender] >= _value && _value > 0' allows attackers to set balances to 2^256, causing a denial of service attack.

The fallback function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function 'totalEthInWei = totalEthInWei + msg.value' allows attackers to overflow 'totalEthInWei' to a very large value, causing a denial of service attack.
The constructor function has a typo, causing it to be executed as a regular function, which devalued the token, allowing attackers to steal it.
